'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Mark Peterson DS My Kind Of Scum''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' This MKOS is Slightly Better Than Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
